issue_context.title: Trend sensors throw errors on startup
issue_context.body:
**The problem**

Whenever I restart HA I see a few errors that look like this:
```
2021-02-06 17:28:20 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.trend.binary_sensor] could not convert string to float: 'not set'
2021-02-06 17:28:20 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.trend.binary_sensor] could not convert string to float: 'not set'
```
I have exactly two `trend` sensors in my config so basically each one is doing this every startup.

This isn't actually an issue once HA gets going since the entities these trend sensors look at do exist. It seems to be an ordering problem where the trend sensors throw exceptions because they load before the entities they are watching do so they get a non-float value looking up the state.

Could trend sensors somehow delay this initial check? Like I get that they want to throw an error if the entity they are supposed to be watching actually doesn't exist for some reason. But they seem to do this first check too early since not all the other entities they could be watching have loaded yet. Some possible solutions I can think of:
1) Move the `trend` integration to the end of the loading process to ensure whatever its watching has already loaded
2) Ignore the failure on the very first check unless the watched entity continues to not exist after a set period of time (30 seconds maybe?)
3) Don't log an error if the watched entity has an invalid state and instead just set the sensor's state to `unavailable`

Might be others, not sure, just would like it not to log these errors every startup.

**What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?**

core-2021.2.1

**What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?**

_No response_

**What type of installation are you running?**

Home Assistant OS

**Integration causing the issue**

trend

**Link to integration documentation on our website**

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/trend/

**Example YAML snippet**

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line
sensor:
- platform: trend
  sensors:
    mike_traveling_home:
      entity_id: proximity.mike_to_home
      device_class: moving
      friendly_name: Mike traveling home
      max_samples: 1000
      sample_duration: 300
      min_gradient: -1.2
    kylee_traveling_home:
      entity_id: proximity.kylee_to_home
      device_class: moving
      friendly_name: Kylee traveling home
      max_samples: 1000
      sample_duration: 1200
      min_gradient: -1.2
```


**Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?**

```txt
# Put your logs below this line
2021-02-06 17:28:20 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.trend.binary_sensor] could not convert string to float: 'not set'
2021-02-06 17:28:20 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.trend.binary_sensor] could not convert string to float: 'not set'
```
